name: cf-usage-dashboard
description: Self-hosted Cloudflare usage dashboard on Workers: CDN, Bot Management, DNS, Spectrum, Images and developer platform usage from the GraphQL Analytics API, with monthly caps and webhook / ntfy alerts.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token for reading analytics. Permissions: Account Analytics Read, Zone Analytics Read and Zone Read (all zones). Optional: Zone Settings Read for Spectrum IPv4 counts.

DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.description: Password for the dashboard (HTTP Basic auth, any username). Use a long random string.

ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the account the API token belongs to; set it if the token can see several accounts.
